'''MephitaPharma, Inc''' was a chemical manufacturer that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The company owned a chemical factory on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Su'ock Ytam]] worked for them in the facility, as a chemist. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], MephitaPharma had discontinued their Tilnes operation and abandoned their factory there.
